subject: Multi-jurisdiction tax nexus & VAT ID validation for reseller-led billing
messages:
From: Amelia Ward <amelia.ward@cloudretailer.de>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-04 09:12 +01:00
Subject: Tax routing for ResellCo distribution of Redwood seats

Hi Dylan,

Quick one — our ResellCo GmbH partner (resells Redwood subscriptions to EU merchants) is asking how Redwood wants invoices handled for October orders. They usually re-invoice their customers and want to know whether Redwood should invoice CloudRetailer directly (net of VAT) or issue invoices to ResellCo and rely on a reverse-charge flow. Two specifics they asked: 

- Does Redwood accept reseller self-billing (ResellCo issues final invoice to end-customer, Redwood invoices ResellCo) or do you prefer marketplace/reseller invoicing with an RC on the reverse leg?
- What evidence do you require for VAT ID validation to avoid VAT collection in Germany? (They asked about a dated VAT certificate + EU VIES check)

Can we get coordination from finance and legal so they can close the PO? PO attached.

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Ward
Head of Procurement
CloudRetailer GmbH

Attachment: CloudRetailer_PO_43321.pdf
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Amelia Ward <amelia.ward@cloudretailer.de>; marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com; lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-04 10:05 +01:00
Subject: Re: Tax routing for ResellCo distribution of Redwood seats

Hi Amelia — thanks for the note and the PO. Looping in Marcus (finance) and Lauren (legal). High-level proposal from our side:

- Preferred flow: Redwood invoices ResellCo for the gross amount and ResellCo then issues invoices to their end-customers. For B2B EU customers where reverse-charge applies, we can issue invoices without VAT provided ResellCo supplies valid VAT IDs and self-billing agreement evidence.
- Evidence needed: reseller VAT certificate, a signed reseller self-billing addendum (if ResellCo will be issuing the final invoices), and VIES confirmation for end-customer VAT IDs where reverse-charge is claimed.

If that works, Marcus — can you confirm the exact document checklist and whether we need the signed reseller agreement before processing the PO?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com; lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com; monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-04 11:22 +01:00
Subject: Re: Tax routing for ResellCo distribution of Redwood seats

Thanks — quick finance confirm:

1) We can accept Redwood -> ResellCo invoices (ResellCo will be our customer) provided we have:
   - Current German VAT registration for ResellCo (certificate PDF),
   - Signed reseller self-billing addendum (one-page amendment to SOW),
   - PO on file (we have CloudRetailer's PO attached now).

2) Reverse-charge treatment on the ResellCo -> end-customer leg is ResellCo's responsibility; however, for us to apply zero-rated VAT on our invoice to ResellCo we need proof ResellCo is established in EU and a valid VAT ID on VIES for the entity they claim. For end-customers (if ResellCo claims RC for B2B), we ask for a CSV of end-customer VAT IDs and a note that ResellCo will maintain the VIES checks and local documentation.

3) Nexus edge-case: If ResellCo is billing customers in jurisdictions where Redwood has nexus or local presence (e.g., UK entity or any future local EU subsidiary), we reserve the right to re-evaluate tax treatment. Please flag if CloudRetailer customers are in the UK specifically.

Actionables:
- Dylan/Commercial: get signed reseller addendum and ResellCo VAT cert.
- Monica (Billing): hold invoices in suspense until docs are validated; create suspense code RC-RESALE-10.

Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Please send us your German VAT registration PDF and a signed one-page self-billing addendum (we attached a template below).
- If you intend to claim reverse-charge on end-customer invoices, confirm you will hold end-customer VAT IDs and VIES confirmations; provide a sample CSV export and your standard self-billing process notes.

Template addendum: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVAT-matrix (see file VAT_nexus_matrix_v1.xlsx)

If you can't provide these immediately, we can temporarily route the invoice through our EU marketplace flow (which will collect VAT at checkout) but that may change the commercial net to ResellCo.
